prompt: When I reopen a document, the layers panel should show the same groups and frames expanded as when I last saved it. At the moment everything comes back collapsed and I have to open my groups again every time.
reference: Keeps the expanded ids in the view state that is saved beside the document, and the layers panel reads them from there.

naive.summary: Stores an expanded flag on group and frame nodes (written to the document file) and restores the panel from it on load.
